linkedDevelopment.definition: Full photographs, actual person detector and body wrist ROI. PCK10 against provider automatic hand labels, normalized by 1.3 times annotated box side; missing/hidden points count as incorrect in allPointPck10.

linkedTest.definition: Full photographs, actual person detector and body wrist ROI. PCK10 against provider automatic hand labels, normalized by 1.3 times annotated box side; missing/hidden points count as incorrect in allPointPck10.

note: New subjects excluded from original 2240 image collection. Auto-label agreement is not human-verified anatomical accuracy.
changes: Original body refinement; conservative hand confidence/size; rotated ROI recovery and own-model region refinement; partial-pose duplicate rejection.
limitations: Provider auto-labels are not manual anatomical truth. Cropped metrics require GT boxes/orientation. Full-photo figures include detector/wrist/ROI errors. Displayed-point metric concerns matched hands; hand precision separately counts unmatched predictions. Development/trial checks reused these cases for pipeline iteration; not a certified independent benchmark.
